provenance.latin: Traditional prayer texts and mystery names checked against the Vatican Compendium; accents, capitalization and punctuation normalized. Fatima prayer uses the common Domine Iesu variant (maxime indigent).
provenance.english: Traditional English prayer wording; direct project translation for mystery announcements. Not a reproduction of modern Scripture translations.
provenance.practice: Five decades, Apostles’ Creed opening, customary optional Fatima prayer included after each decade; standard weekly schedule without seasonal Sunday overrides.
provenance.timing: Estimated silent-reading durations, not recorded audio cues.

passages.latin: In nómine Patris, et Fílii, et Spíritus Sancti. Amen.
passages.english: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

passages.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis: sanctificétur nomen tuum;
passages.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name;

passages.latin: advéniat regnum tuum; fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo, et in terra.
passages.english: thy kingdom come; thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

passages.latin: Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie,
passages.english: Give us this day our daily bread,

passages.latin: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris.
passages.english: and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

passages.latin: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem; sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
passages.english: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

passages.latin: Ave, María, grátia plena, Dóminus tecum.
passages.english: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.

passages.latin: Benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
passages.english: Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

passages.latin: Sancta María, Mater Dei, ora pro nobis peccatóribus, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.
passages.english: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

passages.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
passages.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.

passages.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc et semper, et in sæcula sæculórum. Amen.
passages.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

passages.latin: Credo in Deum, Patrem omnipoténtem, Creatórem cæli et terræ.
passages.english: I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth.

passages.latin: Et in Iesum Christum, Fílium eius únicum, Dóminum nostrum,
passages.english: And in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord,

passages.latin: qui concéptus est de Spíritu Sancto, natus ex María Vírgine,
passages.english: who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary,

passages.latin: passus sub Póntio Piláto, crucifíxus, mórtuus et sepúltus;
passages.english: suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried;

passages.latin: descéndit ad ínferos; tértia die resurréxit a mórtuis;
passages.english: he descended into hell; on the third day he rose again from the dead;

passages.latin: ascéndit ad cælos, sedet ad déxteram Dei Patris omnipoténtis;
passages.english: he ascended into heaven and sits at the right hand of God the Father almighty;

passages.latin: inde ventúrus est iudicáre vivos et mórtuos.
passages.english: from there he will come to judge the living and the dead.

passages.latin: Credo in Spíritum Sanctum, sanctam Ecclésiam cathólicam, sanctórum communiónem,
passages.english: I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints,

passages.latin: remissiónem peccatórum, carnis resurrectiónem, vitam ætérnam. Amen.
passages.english: the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.

passages.latin: Dómine Iesu, dimítte nobis débita nostra, salva nos ab igne inférni,
passages.english: O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell,

passages.latin: perduc in cælum omnes ánimas, præsértim eas quæ misericórdiæ tuæ máxime índigent. Amen.
passages.english: lead all souls to heaven, especially those most in need of thy mercy. Amen.

passages.latin: Salve, Regína, mater misericórdiæ; vita, dulcédo et spes nostra, salve.
passages.english: Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy; hail, our life, our sweetness, and our hope.

passages.latin: Ad te clamámus, éxsules fílii Hevæ.
passages.english: To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve.

passages.latin: Ad te suspirámus, geméntes et flentes in hac lacrimárum valle.
passages.english: To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears.

passages.latin: Eia ergo, advocáta nostra, illos tuos misericórdes óculos ad nos convérte.
passages.english: Turn then, most gracious advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us.

passages.latin: Et Iesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui, nobis post hoc exsílium osténde.
passages.english: And after this our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

passages.latin: O clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo María.
passages.english: O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

passages.latin: Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
passages.english: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.

passages.latin: Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
passages.english: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

passages.latin: Orémus. Deus, cuius Unigénitus per vitam, mortem et resurrectiónem suam nobis salútis ætérnæ præmia comparávit,
passages.english: Let us pray. O God, whose only-begotten Son, by his life, death, and resurrection, has purchased for us the rewards of eternal life,

passages.latin: concéde, quæsumus: ut hæc mystéria sacratíssimo beátæ Maríæ Vírginis Rosário recoléntes,
passages.english: grant, we beseech thee, that while meditating upon these mysteries of the most holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary,

passages.latin: et imitémur quod cóntinent, et quod promíttunt assequámur. Per Christum Dóminum nostrum. Amen.
passages.english: we may imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
